Payload Pitch.name: Payload Pitch
Payload Pitch.description: The user floats a car, a vending machine or a steel beam, hurls it with a single hand while it weighs nothing, and gives its full weight back the instant it strikes. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage and knocks the target and anyone beside them flat; returning only part of the weight instead pins the target against a wall or the ground, unhurt, until they heave it off with a hard effort or the user lifts it away. Strain: heavy.
